themes.summary: Anthropic filed a confidential S-1 (6/2), positioning it as a possible >$1T US IPO alongside OpenAI and SpaceX; PBC structure and unresolved Pentagon tension flagged as risk factors for investors.
SpaceX disclosed (6/4) plans to raise $75b at a $1.77T valuation (555.6m shares @ $135, 100% primary), expected to price 6/11 and trade 6/12 as SSMR/EROC/etc. IPO window stays hot.

themes.theme: Pro sports dealmaking keeps repricing franchises
themes.summary: San Diego Padres sold for a record $3.9b, Sixth Street bought 10% of the SF Giants for $3.8b, Tampa Bay Rays fetched $1.7b — all cited (6/1) as context for looming MLB labor tension over salary caps/floors.

themes.theme: Universal Music Group take-private saga continues, then reverses
themes.summary: UMG rejected a Pershing Square takeover offer ($65b reported 6/1, $63b reported 6/4); Ackman then said he'd sell Pershing Square's 4.4% UMG stake for an expected $600m+ profit after ~5 years, ending his multi-year campaign.

Anne Neuberger (ex-deputy national security advisor) joined a16z as full-time partner and first head of global affairs, reflecting deepening ties between venture capital, defense tech, and sovereign wealth funds as LPs/co-investors.

themes.theme: Healthcare/biotech saw heavy deal volume but weak headline signal
themes.summary: A large share of the week's VC and PE deals were healthcare/biotech (Contraline, Subtle Medical, Oak Hill Bio, IMU Biosciences, Semble, CereVasc, Parabilis Medicines IPO terms, HPS/Discovery Behavioral Health, Sheridan/Tres Health, WestView/Helio Health, etc.), but per standing preference this sector is downweighted in the write-up.
